subject: Math
prompt:
Marcus sets aside $\frac{3}{8}$ of the $$184$ he earns each week from his part-time job. If Marcus continues to set aside money at this rate, how much money, in dollars, will Marcus set aside in $7$ weeks?

$$0$$

$$483$$
explanation: The correct answer is $483$. It's given that Marcus sets aside $\frac{3}{8}$ of the $$184$ he earns each week. Therefore, Marcus sets aside \left( \frac{3}{8} \right) \left( \184 \right), or \$$69, per week. If Marcus continues to set aside money at this rate of $$69$ per week for $7$ weeks, then he will set aside a total of $\left( 7 \right) \left( 69 \right)$, or $483$, dollars.
